title: Capability Hub
flywheelIntro: Pick a category, then a sub-stage. Marketing follows the 1–6 flywheel; education is a separate learning toolkit; brainstorming uses persona lenses.
loopHint: Insights from measurement flow back to research, closing the loop
categoryMediaHint: OOH and digital media: brief → plan → creative → launch → optimize → report
categoryGeoHint: Six GEO stages: baseline → strategy → citability → technical → distribution → monitor
categoryFinanceHint: Research modeling, valuation, FP&A and fintech
categoryEnterpriseComplianceHint: Ops regulation, contracts & bids, HR, corporate and SME policy (Mainland China)
categoryMarketingHint: Flywheel sub-stages (1–6): research → strategy → create → activate → distribute → measure
categoryEducationHint: Browse by school level: preschool, primary, junior high, senior high
categoryBrainstormingHint: Think through problems with distilled celebrity mindsets
